issues.description: The loop condition changed from `i < queue.length` to `i + BATCH <= queue.length`. That only iterates while a full BATCH of items remains, so the final partial batch (queue.length % BATCH items) is never delivered — those emails are silently dropped and `sent` under-reports. The original `i < queue.length` handled the remainder. The visible point of the diff is the added rate-limit sleep; the off-by-a-batch is the buried regression.
